candidates.title: Failure Recovery, Restart Resume & No-Duplicate-Mutation Canary

scores.risk: MEDIUM — controlled failure injection in sandbox
scores.insight_value: VERY_HIGH — addresses the largest capability gap after Happy Path
scores.product_proximity: HIGH — recovery/resume is critical for real supervised operation
scores.security_relevance: HIGH — ensures safe failure modes (no data loss, no duplicate mutations)
scores.architecture_impact: LOW-MEDIUM — may require run-state persistence enhancements
scores.testability: HIGH — failures can be injected and verified deterministically
scores.required_permissions: Sandbox repo write (+ possibly controller restart simulation)
scores.manual_substitution_risk: LOW — failure injection is deterministic and verifiable

candidates.rationale: After successful Happy Path validation (R1-R3), the highest-value next step is proving Positron handles failure gracefully: safe stop, state preservation, correct reconciliation on restart, and no duplicate mutations.

candidates.title: Merge Conflict Handling
candidates.rationale: Merge conflicts are a natural next step but less critical than failure recovery. Can be deferred to R6 or later.

candidates.title: Productive External Repository Pilot

scores.architecture_impact: HIGH — new adapter, new policy gates
scores.testability: LOW — external repo state not fully controllable
scores.reversibility: MEDIUM — PR can be closed but repo history remains
scores.manual_substitution_risk: HIGH — external repo may require manual intervention

candidates.rationale: Too risky before recovery/resume is proven. Premature external repo access could cause real harm without recovery capability.

decision.full_title: POS-NORTHSTAR-R5 — Failure Recovery, Restart Resume & No-Duplicate-Mutation Canary

note: R4 recommends R5 but does NOT execute it. R5 execution requires a separate run card and Human Gate.
